title: Enable OpenClaw 3en_job by deterministic local config
description: Bypass hanging plugin-manager CLI. Back up OpenClaw config and plugin, install only TypeBox locally, merge plugins.load.paths and plugins.entries.3en-job-executor.enabled directly into openclaw.json, preserve allow/deny policy, then verify actual model-free /tools/invoke positive write and negative path escape. Attempt bounded Gateway restart only if hot reload is insufficient; rollback restores config and plugin baseline.
